detailZones.translation: 准备室门口与洗眼设施
detailZones.description: Inspect the preparation doorway, glass cabinet, emergency eyewash and nearby storage.

detailZones.title: Student benches and glassware
detailZones.translation: 学生实验台与玻璃器皿
detailZones.description: Explore the fixed student benches, sinks, stools, outlets, glassware and support fittings.

detailZones.title: Teacher demonstration bench
detailZones.description: Inspect the teacher bench, sink, computer equipment, storage, presentation arm and safety fittings.

detailZones.title: Fume cupboard and instruments
detailZones.description: Inspect the complete fume cupboard, extraction path, stands, clamps, balance and heating equipment.

detailZones.title: Models, windows and safety wall
detailZones.description: Explore the anatomy and molecular models, window planting, display board, safety boxes and protective clothing.

detailZones.title: Microscope workstation
detailZones.description: Inspect the foreground microscope, its optical and mechanical parts, slides, test tubes and workstation furniture.

anchorAudit.rationale: The generated source and final JPEG were inspected at native and final pixels. This scene retains 150 independently pointable objects and visible parts across 6 bounded zones. People, identity, readable text, brands, hidden contents, inferred processes and unsupported states were excluded.
